## Activity

During December 2023, East City Eye Clinic recorded 181 captures. This report summarises activity for the month and provides a concise view of image quality and grading outcomes. The recorded capture volume provides the basis for reviewing the number of images available for assessment and identifying any issues affecting the grading process.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 4 were classified as ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 2.2 per cent. The result should be considered alongside routine local review of capture practice, image quality, and any opportunities to support consistent image acquisition. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

Grading identified 46 referable results. The median lag from image capture to grading was 3 days. This provides the central measure of the time taken for images to progress through grading during December 2023. Overall, the site recorded 181 captures, with 4 ungradable images and 46 referable results. The reported image-quality and grading measures should continue to be monitored through routine site operations and monthly review.
